slack-general.body: Morning everyone! Sprint planning starts in 30 minutes 🗓️
On it — just finishing up the ALPHA-13 fix first.
I'll be a few minutes late, please start without me
No worries Maya. James — any blockers we should know about before we start?
The payment gateway timeout is weirdly only reproducible on staging. Can't replicate locally at all.
That's the Redis connection pool on staging — it's misconfigured. I flagged it last week in #incidents
Oh! That explains everything. Linking ALPHA-13 to that ticket now.
Great catch Alex. Let's make sure we add a staging env check to the sprint retrospective action items.
🔔 ALPHA-13 status updated to In Progress by James T.
Here now, sorry! Did I miss anything important?
Just the Redis discovery — scroll up. Kicking off planning now.
Quick question — are we still targeting the March 10 release for ALPHA-12?
Yes, that's still the plan. Auth needs to be merged by Thursday EOD to give QA two days.
I can do a first review pass today if you push a draft PR
Perfect, will have it up by 2pm 👍

slack-engineering.body: Pushed the new CI config — pipeline is now ~40% faster on average. Caching node_modules between runs.
That's a huge improvement. What was the bottleneck before?
npm install was running fresh every time. Also split the lint and test steps so they run in parallel now.

slack-incidents.body: 🚨 P2 Alert: Staging Redis connection pool exhausted. 3 services degraded.
On it. Increasing max connections and restarting the pool.
Resolved. Pool config updated, all services back to normal. Root cause: max_connections was set to 10 instead of 100.

slack-beta-dev.body: The webhook retry logic PR is up for review — #201. Took a slightly different approach than we discussed.
The exponential backoff library we were going to use has a memory leak bug open for 8 months. Wrote a small util instead.
Smart. I'll take a look now.
Also — heads up, the emails not sending issue (#203) is a Sendgrid API key rotation. Rotating now.

slack-beta-releases.body: v1.4.2 deployed to production ✅ — JWT middleware refactor + Redis cache layer.
Smooth deploy! No incidents on the monitor.

Yesterday: Dashboard wireframes v2. Today: Presenting to stakeholders at 2pm. Blockers: none.

Yesterday: CI optimisation. Today: Staging Redis fix. Blockers: none.

teams-design.body: Sharing the new dashboard wireframes v2 — incorporated the feedback from last week.
These look great! The sidebar is much cleaner. One thing — can we move the filter bar to the top?
Yep, easy change. I'll update the Figma and reshare.

discord-general.body: Anyone else getting 429s from the GitHub API? Rate limit seems lower than usual.
Yeah, GitHub changed the unauthenticated rate limits last week. We need to add auth to all our API calls.
Already created BETA-08 for it. Will tackle after #201 is merged.
📌 BETA-08 created: Add GitHub auth to API calls
Also heads up — our Discord server is getting indexed by some search bots. Worth making invite-only if it isn't already.
Already invite-only on my end. Maybe a server settings sync issue?
I can check the server settings tonight.

discord-dev.body: FYI — migrated all our infra scripts to use pnpm. Faster installs and better lockfile handling.
Nice. Will update the local setup docs.
